scope: Publication artifact integrity and independent primary-k numeric validation of all 200 completed raw-MI jobs; no native inference or complete independent scorer rerun
limitations: The 1200 stored artifact SHA256 values and byte sizes were independently recomputed; all 200 primary-k results were independently recalculated, but this is not a complete independent correctness proof of the original scorer.

All raw adjacency bytes were read for hashing and raw headers were independently checked; the approximately 978 million source-target entries were not independently reparsed for pair uniqueness or MI values. Stored parser-validation counts were checked against the fixed plan.
All 200 dense score arrays were independently loaded and checked for shape, finite nonnegative values and primary-k metrics; they were not compared element-by-element to the original adjacencies.

Independent sklearn AUROC sorting covered four newly run jobs (seeds 1 and 100, both arms), not all 200. All 200 reported AUROC values were checked for finiteness and agreement with their existing scorer integral checks.
The fixed label vector was checked for shape, class counts and byte identity to the prior pilot, not reconstructed anew from the response TSV in this audit.
One hundred computational resamples are not independent biological replicates; perturbation-response labels do not prove direct regulation.

primary_at_5000.method: Independent numpy.partition kth-score boundary, greater-than/equal-to Boolean counts and uniform boundary-tie expectation; no calls to benchmark score_arrays or metric helpers

AUROC_independent_crosscheck.method: sklearn.metrics.roc_auc_score on saved scores and the fixed Boolean label vector

limitations: The fixed label vector was checked for shape/class counts and byte identity to the prior pilot, not reconstructed anew from the response TSV in this numeric stage.
Independent sklearn AUROC sorting covered four newly run jobs (seeds 1 and 100, both arms), not all 200.
Primary-k metrics were independently recalculated for all 200 saved score arrays; the full per-pair adjacency-to-array conversion was not independently repeated.
